brief: Mizuho maintains Outperform on NVDA ($250 PT) after NY Times and WSJ reports that CEO Jensen Huang faces another affair allegation with a direct-report employee and that NVDA's board is looking to oust him, sending the stock down ~9% after-hours and ~11% since Monday versus SPX up 1% and SOX down 2%. Mizuho believes Jensen, who built NVDA to ~$4.5Tr market cap over 33 years, could step down as CEO but stay on as non-executive chairman, and expects the uncertainty to be a significant distraction for 6-7 months, implying a key-person-risk discount in the pullback. Mizuho argues the selloff makes NVDA attractive at ~11x F28E P/E against ~71%/73% revenue/EPS growth, and keeps its AI infrastructure thesis (>$3-4T TAM by 2030E, Blackwell/Vera Rubin ramps, FCF funding hyperscalers) intact, seeing upside into Nov 17 OctQ/JanQ earnings on GB300/VR200 momentum. Risks: execution during a CEO transition, China export restrictions and Taiwan tensions, CoWoS capacity, and FTC scrutiny.
